description: TopoFlow official example Treynor_Iowa_30m / __No_Infil_June_20_67_Rain (kinematic-wave channels, rain only, no infiltration; storm of 20 June 1967 on the 0.396 km2 Treynor watershed, Iowa, 30 m grid). Run stops by the official rule: outlet Q falls to 5% of its peak.
engine_version: TopoFlow 3.71 (2023-09-25) as printed by the model; source peckhams/topoflow36 commit a1c07d0a72185cbd0baeff1ef77feadad09c3f88 (installed copy has local patches, see README)
recorded_with: run_reference.py through KI tool tools/run_topoflow.py, engine python /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/TopoFlow/venv/bin/python (Python 3.12.3, numpy/scipy/netCDF4 1.7.4)
reference: Upstream ships no model reference output for this case (only observed discharge in __observations/, not used as a check). Values below come from our own real run, run twice: every value matched exactly, and the 0D-Q.txt and raw .rts grid files were byte-identical between the two runs.
run_setup_changes_in_temp_copy: June_20_67_path_info.cfg: out_directory ~/TF_Output/Treynor -> temp dir (path setting only)
June_20_67_rain_rates.txt: byte-identical copy also placed in Treynor_Iowa_30m/ (the in_directory '..'), because the meteorology component reads it there (file layout only)

June_20_67_providers.txt: line 'ice tf_ice_gc2d' commented out. The ice component is 'Disabled' in its own cfg; a disabled ice component sets no h_ice and the framework crashes while linking components (also with unmodified upstream HEAD code). Disabled ice gives zero melt; the report shows vol_IM = 0.

numeric_checks.name: n_timesteps_driver
numeric_checks.why: number of 6 s driver steps until the Q_peak_fraction stop rule fired

numeric_checks.name: Q_peak_m3s
numeric_checks.why: peak outlet discharge (6 s resolution) from the model report

numeric_checks.name: vol_P_m3
numeric_checks.why: total rain volume over the DEM

numeric_checks.name: vol_edge_m3
numeric_checks.why: water that left the DEM boundary

numeric_checks.name: vol_chan_final_m3
numeric_checks.why: water left in channels at stop

numeric_checks.name: mass_balance_rel_error
numeric_checks.why: model's own mass balance check (vol_error / vol_in)

numeric_checks.name: hydrograph_0D_Q_max_m3s
numeric_checks.why: max of main outlet column Q_34_16 in 0D-Q.txt

numeric_checks.name: hydrograph_0D_Q_sum_x60s_m3
numeric_checks.why: sum of outlet Q x 60 s (should be close to vol_Q)

numeric_checks.name: grid_2D_Q_max_m3s
numeric_checks.why: max Q over all cells and frames in 2D-Q.nc

numeric_checks.name: grid_2D_Q_last_frame_max_m3s
numeric_checks.why: max Q in the last saved grid frame

notes: Finished-normally checks (not numeric): return code 0, KI tool JSON status 'success', model lines 'Simulation complete.', 'Finished. (June_20_67)' and 'Stopping: Reached Q_peak fraction = 0.05.'. For context only: the official observed discharge file (__observations/June_20_1967_Observed_Discharge.txt, not packaged) has a peak of about 12.4 m3/s.
